# AgentMesh-CreatorCut

AgentMesh-CreatorCut is the AgentMesh360 intelligent post-production product
for existing talking-head recordings and product screen recordings.

Product contract:

- Public local client: media import, Chinese/English/mixed transcription,
  preview, reversible edit execution, captions, music, and export.
- Private cloud Director: interactive decision cards, semantic edit strategy,
  review, signed declarative plans, idempotency, and recovery.
- AgentMesh Core: identity, entitlement, the authoritative 50-credit price,
  debit, and refund ledger.
- Original media, voice, local transcript files, previews, and exports are not
  uploaded to the Director.
- One confirmed signed Director plan costs 50 AgentMesh credits.
- Local execution consumes no cloud credits.

Official install:

- macOS or Ubuntu:
  curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiyangnan/AgentMesh-CreatorCut/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
- Windows PowerShell:
  irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jiyangnan/AgentMesh-CreatorCut/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex

The official installer verifies all dependencies, the signed client release,
and the public Director trust bundle, then starts `creatorcut onboard`.
`creatorcut onboard` is resumable and returns the exact next action for secure
login, local recording import, bilingual transcription, explicit context
consent, and Director start. Never request an API key in command arguments.

Official site: https://creatorcut.agentmesh360.com/
Public repository: https://github.com/jiyangnan/AgentMesh-CreatorCut
